scope: Original nonliving entity/item callbacks and preservation of living-mob validation
exercised_paths: Actual Gun/RayGun/ShrinkRay/Frisbee/EvilEgg item use, original durability and stack costs
Original shooter references and launch motion; original Frisbee null-owner constructor policy
Canceled native spawn rollback and retry
Exact-once original tick and explicit superclass phases, with no forced native item travel
Bullet entity hit, Rocket/Fireball block hit, controlled embedded Frisbee owner-only pickup
Original Money pickup and empty GooDonut pickup override
Native spawn/metadata codecs, original scalar and common fields, dimensions/bounds and registry NBT
Original sprite renderer geometry and normalized single-cell atlas UVs; no invented renderer for rendererless originals
original_policy_notes: Frisbee constructor does not assign its private owner field; controlled owner-only pickup is tested separately.
Rocket and DesertLizardFireball have no original renderer registration.
GooDonut intentionally overrides pickup with an empty method.
limitations: Headless actual-mod tests and CPU renderer capture only; genuine ClientLevel ticking and GPU drawing remain unverified.
Living roster checks do not prove every specialized AI decision or subtype.
Atlas quad mapping supports sampling within a single cell; cross-cell sampling is rejected.
Admission inspects original ancestry and direct API references, not arbitrary helper-class method bodies.
